response.justification: Technically strong senior individual contributor with 15+ years of hands-on full-stack, embedded, and open-source work, plus a Linux/OSS mindset and founder experience running an open-source geodata platform. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position requiring German at C1 minimum — the candidate lists only basic German, which is disqualifying for client-facing architecture and advisory work in a German consulting context. The resume also shows no formal team leadership, line management, or technical project management titles, and no evidence of UML/formal modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance/risk experience, which are core requirements here. Would be a strong fit for a senior/staff engineer role, but not for Head of Development as specified.
strengths: 15+ years broad hands-on engineering across web, embedded, and high-throughput microservices
Deep open-source and Linux orientation; founded and maintains an OSS geodata platform
Proven knowledge-sharing: conference talks, multi-day workshops, and courses (mentoring potential)
concerns: German only 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely a hard blocker
No formal leadership, line-management, or technical project management experience
No evidence of UML/modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance/risk work

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership / team management track record
Deep open-source, Linux, and broad senior engineering experience
